title_zh: 商定为试办保留两小时准备时间

scenario.label_zh: 商定为试办保留两小时准备时间
scenario.goal_zh: 澄清试办准备不能挤入已满日程或要求加班，并同意调整任务保留两小时

context_zh: 两位同事评估一个小型客户接待试办方案。
author: author-phase11-c

sentences.speaker: Hana
sentences.text: There’s merit in trying a shorter welcome session, but who will prepare it?

sentences.speaker: Ben
sentences.text: I was hoping you could. It’s a mere two hours of preparation.

sentences.speaker: Hana
sentences.text: Two hours still have to come from somewhere. My objection is to fitting it around a full schedule, not to the idea itself.

sentences.speaker: Ben
sentences.text: Fair point. I was merely assuming you could fit those two hours in. I should have checked your schedule. You shouldn’t have to work late.

sentences.speaker: Hana
sentences.text: Could we move Tuesday’s filing task and protect those two hours?

sentences.speaker: Ben
sentences.text: Yes. I’ll move that task to my list and block Tuesday morning for your preparation.

sentences.speaker: Hana
sentences.text: Then I’m happy to run the trial session.
